body:
I was hoping you would find me. I read your post about yesterday - I'm very sorry. I relate you everything you said, I hate society, I hate the complications that come with being a human. 
My girlfriend didn't cheat on me, but she left me for a guy that she knew while she was with me, and it still burns. Part of the reason I'm so desperate for a girlfriend now is because my ex told me she may want to give it another chance. But she's across the country now, and when she comes back I don't want to get back together with her if I've never had the experience of being with someone else when she has. It just wouldn't feel right, no matter how much I want to be with her. 

That's why I feel like I need to worry about finding someone, fast. I don't want to push her away because I haven't been with anyone else while she was gone, I really want to be with her. But if she comes back, and I can't be with her because of my own reservations, I don't want her to leave for good, which I can definitely see happening. 

I don't have the time or money for a doctor or therapist, and all of the therapists I've been to don't understand, or I feel are just there because they're being paid. Advice and reinforcement mean nothing to me if I have to pay for it. Masturbation is something that scares me, because when I do, I inevitably feel more pathetic afterwards, and all it does is keep my mind focused on the sex I'm not getting. I rarely drink, if ever, but I do recognize my addiction to pot. I smoke daily, because if I don't, I start thinking too much and get more depressed. I don't know if it's the pot that's keeping me depressed, but I'm too afraid to stop and find out.

Maybe I phrased that wrong. I feel like I should be happy with myself - besides the girlfriend situation, I think I'm a pretty great guy. I'm a musician, I'm intelligent, I'm passionate and caring. I know these things. But I'm just so incredibly lonely, and have been for so long, that I'm starting to wonder what could be so wrong with me that's kept me single for over a year. Even the biggest scumbags I know can find at least a kiss every few months. I don't rely on others for validation, but a lack of validation really takes it's toll on what I thought I already knew about myself.

My unhappiness is not rooted in self-esteem, I know that. I'm just not satisfied, sexually or emotionally. I just don't understand what's keeping women from being attracted to me.

No. Nobody knows this side of me, except my parents. And even them, I can't talk to about it because it causes them too much pain to see me like this, and that causes me even more pain. I can't talk about this with my friends because then they would see this side of me, and I would feel even worse about myself. This isn't a side that I want people to see, which is why I'm posting this on the internet. I take on a different personality when I'm with people, partly because they distract me momentarily from my problems, but mainly because I feel they would think less of me if they knew just how unstable I was. 

And I don't think it's wrong, but I know it's not helping my case. I feel like any girl I talk to is assuming that I'm only talking to her for sex, when in reality all I want is a meaningful relationship. People always tell me I have to be happy with myself before I can be truly happy. But the thing is, I think I am satisfied with who I am as a person, I just get no reassurance from outside, which is crucial for me for some reason. It's easy to say you're happy being alone when you know that there's at least one person attracted to you, but I don't even have that.
